query: What is the procedure for contesting a traffic challan in Tamil Nadu?
reference_answer:
Contesting a Traffic Challan:
To contest a traffic challan in Tamil Nadu:
1. Check the challan details
2. Visit the Tamil Nadu Police website or the issuing police station
3. Submit a written appeal within the specified time frame (usually 15 days)
answer: To contest a traffic challan in Tamil Nadu, you can approach a Magistrate within 15 days of receiving the challan. Alternatively, you can file an appeal online through the Tamil Nadu Police website. [Document 1]
